verdict_detail: Every one of the 42 differing bytes across both roles is the bound product identity or a checksum over it. No opcode, no table shape, no code or data beyond identity changed. claim_limit: Byte attribution of one role pair only. No acceptance, promotion or release claim; H-F2 remains not green.
